_note: Extracted from the mockups. Dark mode only so far; light mode mirrors it and is not designed.

colorMeaning.astronaut: an astronaut is involved (owns or did the work)
colorMeaning.warning: waiting on a human, at risk

tintRule: State tints are the state color at roughly 8 to 12 percent opacity over the surface, with a 1px border in the full color.

spacing.rule: every padding, margin, gap and size is a multiple of 4px

radius.rule: 0px or 4px only; no pills unless a design calls for one

background: Static starfield: three tiny radial-gradient dots tiled at 300x120, very low opacity. No animation.
motion: Slow orbit pulse on active astronaut avatars; short trail when a card moves columns; all disabled under reduced motion.
